scripts.prebuild: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'), path = require('path'); try { require.resolve('next', { paths: [process.cwd()] }); } catch (e) { console.log('[DUMLINE Web] Installing workspace dependencies for build...'); const root = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '../..'); try { cp.execSync('npm ci', { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: root }); } catch (err) { cp.execSync('npm install', { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: root }); } }"
